clips.title: The story
paras: Atop Thorn Hill, Thun'grim Firegaze keeps to a reclusive life and a solitary forge. After their first lessons in defense, Horde warriors cross the Barrens to find him and seek steel fit for their growing skill.

After you show skill in the defensive arts under veteran trainers like Uzzek, you are sent to sharpen your fighting with suitable steel. Ordinary armories can carry a frontline fighter only so far. True mastery calls for a personal weapon from a smith of renown. In the Barrens, Thun'grim Firegaze is that smith, an aging orc who has left settlement life behind to keep an isolated forge high above the plains.

Thun'grim Firegaze lives atop Thorn Hill, a jagged rise east of the Crossroads where wild raptors and hostile quilboar roam. He spends his solitary hours shaping metal, far from the protection of town walls. Decades of gazing into blistering forge flames have ruined his eyesight, though his instincts remain sharp. When you climb the heights and disturb his solitude, Firegaze knows why: a warrior has come seeking forged steel.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It is vital that a warrior's weapon is one of quality. And if there is an orc who can craft quality weapons, then that orc is Thun'grim Firegaze. He is a hermit who dwells atop the hills east of the Crossroads.
If you seek a weapon, warrior, then you should seek Thun'grim. To find him, first travel to the Crossroads to the west, then strike east into the hills. His camp is high on a hilltop.

clips.title: Completion
paras: My eyes have long dried out from staring into the forge's flame, but some things I can still see. I can see you want something.
And if you found your way here, then I can guess what you desire.
